# #733 — verify-lane.ts runs every done-means check with bash — a .test.ts done-means is executed as a shell script and dies exit 2

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-18T02:13:53Z
Updated: 2026-08-18T02:13:53Z

---

Found during the #724 wave merge pass (2026-08-17). PR #728's Done-means line points at `scripts/run-nats-worker-embed-watermark.test.ts` (a bun test, the natural shape for a code lane). `scripts/verify-lane.ts:473` unconditionally runs `spawnSync("bash", [checkPath])`, so bash parsed TypeScript, errored line-by-line, and exited 2 — correctly posting no receipt, but for the wrong reason: harness error, not a failed check (exit grammar says 2/3-class harness errors are not verdicts).

Fix direction (owner's call): dispatch by extension — `.sh` via bash, `.ts`/`.test.ts` via `bun run test:isolated` (or refuse .ts paths loudly with the wrapper recipe named). Until then every code lane must ship a .sh wrapper, which is what #728 is doing to merge.

Refs #724.
